test_bmg_arithmetic_log: test the BMG compiler log operations including math.log, torch.log, and Tensor.log on constants and stochastic values
test_bmg_arithmetic_add: test the BMG compiler addition operations using the plus operator, Tensor.add, and operator.add
test_bmg_arithmetic_mul: test the BMG compiler multiplication operations using the asterisk operator, Tensor.mul, and operator.mul
test_bmg_arithmetic_pow: test the BMG compiler power operations using the double asterisk operator, Tensor.pow, and operator.pow
test_bmg_arithmetic_exp: test the BMG compiler exponential operations including math.exp, torch.exp, and Tensor.exp on constants and stochastic values
